class: Policy sweep advances unfinished application entry dialogs
symptom: The policy interceptor repeatedly clicked Continue To Application while the modal's fields were still being filled and reported confirmation without dismissal.
root_cause: Only password dialogs were excluded; plain application entry dialogs were treated as policies and unsuccessful clicks were logged as dismissal.
why_tests_missed: Modal checks covered a policy and a password login, but not a non-password application entry dialog.
fix: Defer dialogs containing visible entry fields or file/password controls to the form-filling path; count dismissal only when the modal actually hides.
prevention: Verify no policy sweep clicks occur across repeated passes on a data entry dialog.
